subject: Need one missed notification re-sent to a single endpoint only
body: Our fraud service was offline for roughly 20 minutes yesterday during a deploy and it missed a notification in that window. Everything before and after came through fine. We have three receivers registered and the other two got that same notification without any problem. I want you to push that one message to the fraud service again and only to that one. What I do not want is the other two receivers getting a second copy, because our reconciliation job is not tolerant of that and will double count. Delivery id on the failed one is whd_88fLz2. What is the correct way to do this?
